title: Gunner Rooster
description: Strap an oversized blaster onto a fearless cartoon rooster and storm wacky platform stages—blast goofy baddies, leap hazards, and collect golden feathers.
controls: Use move, jump, and fire controls to blast through side-scrolling stages as the heroic rooster.

zh-CN.title: 枪弹雄鸡
zh-CN.description: 魔性搞笑横版射击枪弹雄鸡：给暴躁大公鸡配上重机枪横冲直撞，跳台狂射奇葩小怪笑点密集爽感十足！
zh-CN.controls: 操控大公鸡奔跑跳跃并开火射击阻路敌人，一路闯关赢取丰厚奖励。
